authority_note: SOURCE_PRESENT is not runtime support. SUPPORTED requires executable backend facts from the read-only probe and passing tests.

source_requirement.android: AVF/crosvm primary with QEMU fallback; hardware virtualization when available
source_requirement.windows: WHPX plus QEMU; software QEMU only as fallback
source_requirement.linux: KVM plus QEMU; software QEMU only as fallback
source_requirement.ios: secondary QEMU/UTM-style path; do not promise Android-equivalent acceleration
source_requirement.web: UI/control may exist, but no local native hypervisor backend is specified

matrix_policy.runtime_promotion_rule: never promote browser source/UI to native local hypervisor
SUPPORTED only after WHPX + QEMU + hardware virtualization are verified
SUPPORTED only after KVM + QEMU + hardware virtualization are verified
SUPPORTED only after AVF + crosvm + hardware virtualization + native permission are verified; QEMU alone remains CONDITIONAL
QEMU remains CONDITIONAL pending device-specific validation

benchmark.method: 5 samples x 100000 lookups after warmup; compare medians
benchmark.100x_claim: NOT_DEMONSTRATED; preliminary measurement refutes 100x for this metric. CI result must replace preliminary value before closure.

refutations: Repository/vendor source presence alone cannot produce SUPPORTED.
Operating-system identity alone cannot invent WHPX/AVF/KVM permission.
100x is never inferred: benchmark computes the ratio and records meets_100x from the measured value.
